prompt: Gao requests a wall space on time. On Friday, he changes only the title. Another participant changes to a different print of unknown width. What should they do?
promptZh: 高準時預留牆面。星期五，他只改標題；另一位參加者換了相片，尚未提供寬度。兩人應怎麼做？

options.text: Gao should tell the guide the new title at the door; the other participant should send the new width first.
options.zh: 高應在入口告知導覽員新標題；另一位參加者應先寄送新相片寬度。
options.whyZh: 只改標題保留原位置，由入口導覽員收新標題；換相片則要先確認寬度。

options.text: Gao should send a width first; the other participant can tell the guide only the new title.
options.zh: 高應先寄寬度；另一位只需告知導覽員新標題。
options.whyZh: 只改題名不需重查寬度，改用不同相片則不能只報題名。

options.text: Both should send only a new title to the guide.
options.zh: 兩人都只須把新標題告訴導覽員。
options.whyZh: 此流程僅適用於相片本身未變；換相片的人還須先提供寬度。

options.text: Both should give up their wall spaces because the deadline has passed.
options.zh: 截止日已過，兩人都應放棄牆面位置。
options.whyZh: 通知明列截止後的更改流程；沒有規定星期四後有變動就失去位置。

explanationZh: 只改標題保留原位置，由入口導覽員收新標題；換相片則要先確認寬度。
evidence: If you change the title after that, keep the same wall space and give the guide the new title at the door. / If you change to a different print, you must send its width first

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you change the title after that, keep the same wall space and give the guide the new title at the door.
If you change to a different print, you must send its width first

vocabulary.note: provisional 指現時可用但之後還能修訂。
